description:
LONE ORBIT is a solo initiative driven by curiosity, creativity and a passion for space exploration. I'm a Software Engineer with experience in AI, software development, data analytics, automation and creative design.

For NASA Space Apps 2026, I'm exploring "Abandoned but not Forgotten", using NASA's open data, research and digital storytelling to uncover the stories of human-made equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Because every mission leaves behind a story worth discovering.
